items.headline: Anthropic Commits $100 Million to Train 10,000 AI Engineers for Businesses
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Frontier Academy, a 12-week program that trains "Frontier Deployed Engineers" (specialists who set up and run AI inside companies) to the same standard as its own staff, starting with enterprise cohorts.
items.why_it_matters: It shows even big companies are short on people who can put AI to work, which means a solo creator or small business who learns these tools well now has a real edge.

categories.title: Tools & Tips for Creators and Small Biz
